claims.claim: In LoreRim, Wyrmstooth only starts after the vanilla quest 'Rise in the East' is complete (MS10 stage >= 100). Sensible Wyrmstooth Prerequisite enforces this by overriding WTWyrmstoothStarter, and the check applies to every MCM option, including 'Immediately'.

claims.claim: The default Main Quest gate is finishing 'The Way of the Voice' (MCM option 4, MQ105 stage >= 160). In the MCM it can be set to any milestone from Unbound to Dragonslayer, or Immediately.

claims.claim: Requiem - Wyrmstooth.esp overrides the WTStartLevel global from 10 to 20.

claims.claim: The courier Theodyn Bienne finds the player, starting from the Bannered Mare (since 1.19.1 also the nearest town). Players can also speak to Lurius Liore at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun directly.

claims.claim: The questline is 'Wyrmstooth' (WTDragonHunt: Bannered Mare, then the road to Falkreath, then Ancient's Ascent) followed by 'Barrow of the Wyrm' (Solitude docks/Red Wave, Stonehollow, Goreduster, Alberthor's draugr mind-transfer, Dimfrost, defend Stonehollow from Vulthurkrah).
claims.source: LoreRim install: Wyrmstooth.esp QUST records

claims.claim: The mod has 20 player-facing quests, including the side quests Someone with Backbone, A Howl Load of Trouble (Faelor wolf follower), A Priceless Commodity (spriggans vs miners choice), The Naked Nord, and the mercenary favor quests.
claims.source: LoreRim install: Wyrmstooth.esp QUST records

claims.claim: A Debt Unpaid is only available after Barrow of the Wyrm. Athir, Daenlit and Shargam can be hired after Vulthurkrah is defeated. Stonehollow rebuilds after Barrow of the Wyrm.
claims.source: WyrmstoothReadme.txt changelog

claims.claim: Fort Valus is a purchasable, upgradeable player fort (quest Reclaiming the Past). The deed reportedly costs 30,000 gold.
claims.source: Wyrmstooth.esp records; Tuxborn overview; annathepiper blog

claims.claim: The mod adds the Shout Fiik Lo Sah (Phantom Form) with 3 new word walls, and Suleyk's dragon priest mask is a playable item.
claims.source: WyrmstoothReadme.txt changelog 1.07/1.18

claims.claim: LoreRim's Settings Loader enables boss health scaling (multiplier 12) for Vulthurkrah, Vulom, Valstadt, Malentis, Suleyk and The Valedrynn. The author's plugin default is off.
claims.source: Settings Loader settings.ini; readme 1.20.2

claims.claim: Wyrmstooth Barrow and Dimfrost have a minimum encounter-zone level of 24.
claims.source: WyrmstoothReadme.txt

claims.claim: Missives - Wyrmstooth Patch adds a Missives board outside the Stonehollow inn. It appears only after the main quest is complete and the town is rebuilt.
claims.source: Nexus 26788 via meta.ini cache; Missives - Wyrmstooth.esp

claims.claim: Wyrmstooth is an island north of Solitude across the Sea of Ghosts, with its own worldspaces (WyrmstoothWorld and Dimfrost). Travel is by the Red Wave from the Solitude docks, with Holmar as the ferryman.

claims.claim: The mod's default trigger is any steal or pickpocket at player level 10 or higher. The author recommends level 15+ (30-35 ideal) and estimates 8-15+ hours.

claims.claim: Main quest objectives: Reach the place; Find the Hall of the Initiation; Reach the other side; Get the four keys; Follow Arenar; Speak with Arenar; Speak with Syloria; Find a way to enter the Mausoleum (Oasis of Mora Sul); Get into position and shoot the Arrow; Return to Seviana.

claims.claim: In 'Memories of the Umbranox', delivering all of Caio's journals to Seviana earns 1000 gold or a spell tome. Missing any journal fails the quest, and the 4th journal is only in chests in Coldharbour's destroyed houses.

claims.claim: In LoreRim the vanilla cure quest VC01 is renamed 'Seeking A Cure' and Falion's ritual always fails. The start routes are the 'Undeath Undone' note, asking Urag, or entering Falion's house as a vampire. The COTN Morthal patch is the final override.
claims.source: LoreRim install: RisingAtDawnQuestOverhaul.esp / RADQO_COTN_Patch.esp records; LoreRim site main quests page

claims.claim: A Forlorn Hope starts with a courier letter from Falion after the player's 3rd level-up following the failed ritual (Falion must be alive). The real cure is daedric essence (Aetherium Forge, from a Daedric artifact) → Phinis Gestor → a potion crafted at the Atronach Forge with vampire dust plus another daedric essence.
claims.source: LoreRim install: Forlorn Hope.esp books/QUST, scripts, FLM ini; Nexus 107939 via meta.ini

claims.source: LoreRim install: soldier_of_stendarr.esp conditions + TIF scripts; Nexus 97984

claims.claim: Leaps Of Faith is a start-game-enabled misc quest with 12 dive spots. Each gives +4% fall-damage resistance (50% for all twelve), and you must land swimming. LoreRim ships a Valtheim 2.0 patch.
claims.source: LoreRim install: LeapsOfFaith.esp; Nexus 53074 cache

claims.claim: Sissel's Book: after Before the Storm and talking to everyone in Rorikstead, Sissel asks for her lost dragon book. The alias is forced to a Skyrim.esm copy of Kolb & the Dragon (REFR 001067B9) in the tundra cell POITundra31.

claims.source: LoreRim install: CRH esp vs Requiem.esp QUST record comparison; plugins.txt; vanilla-quest-overrides.json

claims.claim: Repairing the Cities starts 2-3 days after Ulfric or Tullius dies, once you have left Solitude or Windhelm. Donations at the Temple of the Divines shorten repair time from about 20 days to about 5. Stealing the donations stretches it to about 30.
claims.source: Nexus 20668 via meta.ini; CWRepairs.esp

claims.claim: Return Aegisbane: give the hammer for a leveled reward (Torbjorn relationship 3, he equips it), sell it for 500 coin, or keep it (relationship -4). Starts from Windhelm guard dialogue or by carrying Aegisbane to Torbjorn.
claims.source: LoreRim install: ReturnAegisbane.esp + scripts; Nexus 108242

claims.claim: The LoreRim Followers page gives these start locations: Inigo in Riften Jail (first cell on the left), Lucien at Dead Man's Drink in Falkreath, Katana upstairs in the Winking Skeever, Remi at the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth, Gore at Peak's Shade Tower. claims.source: https://www.lorerim.com/guides/world/followers

claims.claim: Bad Vibrations starts at random once you have heard Inigo's past ('Tell me more about your past.') and learned his brother's name. It runs Snowpoint Beacon → Langley's House (6 Snow Thrush eggs) and rewards the Summon Inigo spell.
claims.source: Nexus 1461 via meta.ini cache + Inigo.esp QUST records

claims.claim: LoreRim layers a Requiem patch for Inigo (Requiem - Inigo.esp) plus its own generated Lulu's Inigo - Reqtificated.esp. It also ships the Official Patch, the Bloodchill Manor patches and a Snowpoint-overhaul Inigo patch that edits the quest-path cells.

claims.claim: Katana: choose 'So, what brings you to Skyrim?' to start. Passing Katana's test skips Chasing the Current, or every quest. Megara is recruited at the Drunken Huntsman after Chasing the Current; Shale at the Bee and Barb after The Ravens' Lament.

claims.claim: LoreRim's Katana LoreCut-Reqtificated patch: Requiem-integrated, rifle replaced by an ebony bow, the 'I'm not from this world' intro option removed, Shale's flirt option removed, Megara's potion buffs nerfed and ingredient pick-up disabled, Katana's lockpicking capped at Adept. It also adds the River's Camp location.
claims.source: Nexus 132964 via meta.ini cache + plugin override list

claims.claim: Chasing the Current is a bounty chain: Lucky Irnsvar (Silent Moons Camp), Galtun Bold-Thief (Kolskeggr Mine), Runir Wulfhart (Broken Helm Hollow), then confronting River at a house near Fort Fellhammer. The Ravens' Lament ends River's threat and frees Shale.
claims.source: Katana.esp QUST records

claims.claim: Remi's recruitment quest The Dwemer Specialist starts at the Silver-Blood Inn and Calcelmo (kill the spider Nimhe), and ends with her repairing the dwemer spider Scrap and joining you.
claims.source: HLIORemi.esp QUST records

claims.claim: Reunion of the Fallen begins with an assassin attack and runs through Solitude (Mercenaries' Ship), Riften (smuggler) and Arkngchal, where you kill her ex-fiancé Morvic. Arkngchal then becomes Remi's workshop for later project quests (crossbow, lantern, tuning fork, tension wrench, Chaurus Pie).
claims.source: HLIORemi.esp QUST records

claims.claim: LoreRim - Remi Patch.esp rebalances Remi, Scrap and Morvic's crew for Requiem. It overrides The Dwemer Specialist record, but no objective or journal text changes.
claims.source: Record inspection/byte diff of LoreRim - Remi Patch.esp vs HLIORemi.esp

claims.claim: Gore's story order: Raven's Flight (Peak's Shade Tower; a kill branch exists) → Wanted → The Drunken Hunted → Blood Ties (Dawnstar, Pate). Blood Ties branches into To Free a Raven, Come, the Crows or The Apple from the Tree, followed by the interludes Where We Stand and Nest Left Empty. The final chapter isn't released.
claims.source: GORE.esp QUST records + Nexus 85298 walkthrough via meta.ini cache

claims.claim: No LoreRim plugin overrides any Gore, Katana, Inigo or Lucien quest records. Remi's starting quest is forwarded unchanged by the LoreRim Remi patch. LoreRim ships no Gore Vigilant addon plugin.
